title: SIDESTORY: ZWILLINGSTÜRME IM HERBST RERUN
lines: 01 SIDESTORY: ZWILLINGSTÜRME IM HERBST RERUN
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 1-10
DETAILS: Zwillingstürme im Herbst event stages will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain event rewards by clearing event stages, completing the Herzenfolgen, and redeeming from Event Store.
EVENT STAGE DURATION:
[Zwillingstürme anbeten] & [Die Gnade ist ewig]& [Die Macht ist grimm]
[ Herzenfolgen ]
DETAILS: During the event, players can submit the suitable Inner Tune in "Herzenfolgen" to complete Routine Visitations and Covert Visitations for rewards.
REWARDS: [★★★★★★: Lessing], Lessing's tokens, Investigation Resupply (provides random materials), etc.
[ Venesuhrenturm ]
DETAILS: During the event, players can complete [Venesuhrenturm] missions by clearing event stages to gain rewards.
REWARDS: Ludwigs-Universität Lecture Hall Furniture (Pieces), Module Materials, Elite Materials, Die Klänge von den Erinnerungen, etc.
[ Herbstmondeskonzert ]

DETAILS: During the event, players can collect [Die Klänge von den Erinnerungen] by participating in the event. [Die Klänge von den Erinnerungen] can be used to redeem items from [Herbstmondeskonzert].
REWARDS: Ludwigs-Universität Lecture Hall Furniture (Pieces), Headhunting Permits, Elite Materials, LMD, Battle Records, etc.
NOTE:

- The requirements to obtain certain medals for this event have been updated. Players who have participated in the original event and met the adjusted requirements will receive the corresponding medals once logged in.
- Once the rerun ends, the Medal Set of this event can no longer be obtained via any method, including the [Side Story].
- This event rerun will carry on the stage progress and First Clear progress.

- The once-only rewards in the rerun will automatically be converted to Intelligence Certificates for players who have already claimed them. Please refer to [Intelligence Certificate Conversion Rules] for more details.
- [Intelligence Certificate Area] will be restocked as the event rerun begins. In addition, new redeemable will be added.
- Operators Virtuosa, Viviana, Lessing, and Bassline will gain more trust during the event rerun.
- After the event rerun ends, the event stages will be available in [Side Story] from June 5, 2025, 04:00 (UTC-7).
02 0011 TEMPEST SERIES NEW ARRIVAL AT THE OUTFIT STORE
DETAILS: The following Outfit will be available at the Outfit Store:
0011 Tempest Series - Ignis Fatuus for Lessing
03 RE-EDITION FURNITURE SET – HERBST MUSIKHAUS & LUDWIGS-UNIVERSITÄT LECTURE HALL
DETAILS: This furniture set will be available again during the event.
Herbst Musikhaus
HOW TO OBTAIN: Limited-time sale at the Store: May 22, 2025, 10:00 - June 5, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
Ludwigs-Universität Lecture Hall
HOW TO OBTAIN:
Zwillingstürme im Herbst event rewards and redeem in Venesuhrenturm and Herbstmondeskonzert (Pieces) Limited-time sale at the Store (Pieces): May 22, 2025, 10:00 - June 5, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
Please stay tuned for more information!
